title: Frozen metric description
responsibility: Explains a measured value and the reviewed limit that applies without treating unavailable data as zero.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.found
inputs.description: The measurement for this unit and metric, or undefined when this revision has no measurement. A null value is shown as unavailable; a present value is rendered with its unit of measure, and partial records can add a note.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.finding
inputs.description: An optional budget finding whose baseline takes priority over the ledger limit; an unavailable status marks review as not measurable. Defaults to undefined; an exceeded finding adds a growth note only when its baseline is present.

inputs.name: harnessBudget.known
inputs.description: The manifest declaration and optional ledger review for a metric. Defaults to {declared: true}; the declaration alone supplies no numeric limit, while a ledger limit or unmeasured marker provides review information.

outputs.name: harnessBudget
outputs.description: A formatted value and limit, with an optional note. The limit prefers a finding baseline, then a reviewed ledger limit, and otherwise describes the applicable no-limit state; values remain explicit when missing or unavailable.

examples.note: Partial: generated source only. Grew from 1024 to 2048 without a recorded approval.

examples.limit: freeze declared; no reviewed limit is recorded at this revision

examples.value: unavailable: source could not be measured
examples.limit: not frozen: reviewed as not measurable
